args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) after the latest deploy. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Monitoring post-rollback health.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks with an elevated error rate (0.18).

2. **Identified target**: From the deployment history, v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

3. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback was verified as rolled out.

4. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident INC-0001 ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy"), which paged the on-call engineer, describing the failure and the rollback.

5. **Verified recovery**: Post-rollback status shows checkout-api healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with error rate back down to 0.002.
